settings.pregunta: Will it jam on my dog's drool?
settings.respuesta: That's the #1 question we get, because it's the reason your last launcher died. Our dual textured flywheels are engineered to grip wet, muddy, or slobbery balls without jamming or stalling out — even after hours of nonstop fetch.

settings.pregunta: Will it break after a few weeks?
settings.respuesta: It runs on sustained-duty DC motors, not toy-grade motors. It also ships with an extended 12–24 month warranty. This isn't a fragile novelty — it's a tool you buy once.

settings.pregunta: Will the noise scare my dog?
settings.respuesta: It runs quiet — no beeping sensor or loud motor sound like some other brands. If your dog is still uneasy, our tranquility guarantee covers a full refund.

settings.pregunta: Will my dog learn to reload it on their own?
settings.respuesta: Honestly: it takes a little training, it's not instant magic. That's why every order includes the 7-Day Self-Reload Protocol, a step-by-step video guide.

settings.pregunta: My dog is a herding breed — will they block the sensor?
settings.respuesta: It can happen — some herding breeds instinctively plant themselves in front of the launcher. We won't promise magic: the included guide walks you through the exact workaround.

settings.pregunta: I already wasted money on a launcher that failed. Why trust this one?
settings.respuesta: You don't pay if it fails. It's that simple — all the risk is on us, not you.

settings.pregunta: Is it a shortcut for actually walking my dog?
settings.respuesta: It's a supplement, not a replacement — think of it as extra, hands-free exercise on top of your normal routine, for the days your dog has more energy than you do.

settings.cuerpo: We'd rather tell you the truth before you buy than after.
